effort.compute_reason: Small model CPU; CGAL Boolean complexity and mesh resolution drive cost, no GPU.

resources.cpu: Small model CPU; CGAL Boolean complexity and mesh resolution drive cost, no GPU.
resources.gpu: None unless a selected dense-reconstruction backend documents GPU acceleration.
resources.ram: Scales with image/cloud/mesh size and selected geometry kernel.
resources.storage: Preserve source plus derived cloud/mesh/CAD artifacts.
variants: accelerated or denser branch where tool supports it
